# Independent top-k operator discovery with boundary telemetry

The first 16-process study stopped on the second arm and did not record which of several checks failed; its outputs are excluded. This separately predeclared study uses the same four ABBA/BAAB blocks, fresh processes, assets, workload and 60 synchronous timed iterations as MICRO-PLAN.md. It replaces the sampling thread with process-boundary snapshots of /proc/stat, runnable threads and build-process count, saves all evidence and traceback before any failed check exits, and reports named checks separately. CPU busy is calculated over each entire process interval, including driver startup; it is not GPU utilization. The same block matching thresholds and analysis gate apply. Check GPU error deltas after every process, stop at the first failure without retry, never pool the interrupted prior run, and preserve the general hold.
